title: r1 minor SO+SA convergent: manifest reference surfaces drop the contract's plugin listings; user settings lack the local overlay
description: Evidence: installed-artifact-manifest.md:5-13 vs contract line 131's starting list ('plugin listings' named; command-listing is an addition not a substitute; user-settings carries no local overlay though the contract says settings come with their local overlays). A wired-but-absent plugin goes unchecked. Disposition: add plugin-listings and user-settings-local surfaces, or record the omission rationale. Data-side. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, installed-artifact-manifest 0.2.0): plugin-listing reference surface added (settings enabledPlugins map plus the user plugin install directory); plugin-set entry records the OBSERVED state — one enabled plugin, rust-analyzer-lsp@claude-plugins-official 1.0.0 at user scope, previously wired and unlisted (the exact gap this finding named); user-settings local-overlay omission recorded as a stated fact of the vehicle (Claude Code defines settings local overlays at project scope only). Round 2 re-verifies (validators: solution-architect + solution-owner convergent).
